request: The default outbound webhook security policy must reject destinations that route to the local host, including unspecified IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, unless explicitly permitted by deployment policy.

defects.description: The reserved network list omits unspecified-address destinations, permitting local-host access through the default SSRF guard.
defects.why_missed: Loopback and private-network examples do not cover unspecified addresses that also route locally.
